summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing a company announcement dated September 8, 2026, disclosing a modest share capital increase from employee warrant exercises. The company issued 28,011 new ordinary shares at exercise prices of DKK 1,334.50, DKK 1,362.50, DKK 1,615.00, and DKK 1,948.00 per share, raising roughly DKK 44.3 million, or about 0.04% of share capital, with no preemption rights. Post-increase capital totals DKK 62,405,855 across 62,405,855 shares. This is a routine equity issuance, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
